newsitem.title: USA: U S West, Continental stand at $21/shr price.
newsitem.headline: U S West, Continental stand at $21/shr price.

text.p: U S West Media Group said Monday it and Continental Cablevision Inc have agreed that each share of U S West stock will be valued at $21 in U S West's purchase of Continental Cablevision.
The merger deal, which is expected to close at the end of November, "remains the same in all other significant respects," U S West said.

Earlier in the day the Wall Street Journal reported that U S West Inc was considering raising the cash portion of its $5.3 billion purchase of Continental to offset a 31 percent drop in the value of U S West stock.
"We're prepared to proceed with the $21 price because, in our view, the stock is currently undervalued by the market," said U S West Chief Executive Richard McCormick.
The initial agreement was based on a U S West share price of between $20.88 and $28.18, the company said.
Media Group shares closed Friday at 16-7/8, but had risen to 17-1/2 in trading Monday.
U S West and Continental Cablevision are having a conference call at 1130 EDT. Participants can call 1-800-207-3317.
